description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts (support+NEI); one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: ERAP1 SNPs are epistatic to HLA alleles for ankylosing spondylitis.
Claim 2: Ethanol stress decreases the expression of IBP in bacteria.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: ERAP1 SNPs are epistatic to HLA alleles for ankylosing spondylitis.
rationale: We also demonstrate that the ERAP1 SNP rs30187 association is not restricted only to carriers of HLA-B*27 but also found in HLA-B*40:01 carriers independently of HLA-B*27 genotype.

seeds.text: Ethanol stress decreases the expression of IBP in bacteria.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is supported by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: ERAP1 SNPs are epistatic to HLA alleles for ankylosing spondylitis.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is not enough info by the evidence
keywords: not enough information to evaluate claim 2
claim_2_verdict.claim: Ethanol stress decreases the expression of IBP in bacteria.

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that eRAP1 SNPs are epistatic to HLA alleles for ankylosing spondylitis.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper B contradicts Claim 1 (ERAP1 SNPs are epistatic to HLA alleles for ankylosing spondylitis.)

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: CONTRADICTED. Claim 2: CONTRADICTED.
